# IToldYouSo Computing

> London-wide Point of Sale (POS), till, and Electronic Point of Sale (EPOS)
> system installation specialist and same-day Information Technology (IT)
> engineering service. Based in Hampstead (North West London) and attending
> client sites across all of Greater London, including Central, North,
> North West, East, South, and West London.

## Flagship Service: London POS, Till & EPOS Installation

IToldYouSo Computing designs, supplies advice for, installs, and troubleshoots
turnkey till and POS systems for retail shops, cafes, restaurants, takeaways,
salons, clinics, and market stalls across London-wide sites.

- Core Till & EPOS Platforms: Square (Register, Stand, Terminal), SumUp
  (Solo, 13-inch Countertop Register), Zettle by PayPal, Clover, Lightspeed,
  Shopify POS, Stripe Terminal, Barclaycard Anywhere, Lloyds Cardnet, and
  Worldpay.
- Hardware & Cabling: Touchscreen counter terminals, thermal receipt printers
  (Epson, Star Micronics), Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), RJ11/RJ12 cash
  drawers, USB/Bluetooth barcode scanners, and reliable Ethernet or Wi-Fi
  network separation for payment devices.
- Turnkey Configuration: Pre-loading menus, product catalogues, Value Added
  Tax (VAT) rates, modifiers, staff permissions, Xero/QuickBooks/Sage links,
  and face-to-face staff training.
- Scheduling & Pricing: £50 per hour for consultation, setup, and training,
  or fixed-price till installation packages quoted upfront. Free initial
  15-minute telephone consultation. Pre-opening and out-of-hours cutovers
  available across London to avoid trading disruption.

- Base Address: Corringham Court, Corringham Road, London NW11 7BY (based in
  Hampstead, North West London)
- Areas Served: All London-wide sites across Greater London — Central London,
  City of London, Westminster, Camden, Hampstead, Highgate, Golders Green,
  Belsize Park, Swiss Cottage, St John's Wood, West Hampstead, Barnet,
  Islington, Hackney, Kensington and Chelsea, Hammersmith and Fulham, Tower
  Hamlets, Southwark, Lambeth, Ealing, Richmond, and surrounding boroughs,
  plus remote United Kingdom (UK) support.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:30 to 19:00 (plus out-of-hours commercial
  POS installations by arrangement).
- Response: Often same-day follow-up and always within 24 hours.

## Sister Practices

For independent United Kingdom (UK) payment provider comparisons, merchant
transaction fee audits, and three-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
modelling across UK card acquirers, visit our sister practice:
- TillSwift Payment Consultation: https://tillswift.com/

For institutional-grade private document retrieval, sovereign Artificial
Intelligence (AI) deployments, and confidential systems advisory for senior
barristers, King's Counsel (KC), and boutique practices, visit our sister
practice:
- Heath & City Technology: https://heathandcity.com/
